name: com.saesentsessis.unity-soa-generator
description:
This package provides light weight Structure of Arrays(SoA) generator.
All SoA's are Burst compatible out of the box.

Extra features:
- (Optional) Nested struct flattening to remove any memory paddings providing zero wasted memory.
- (Optional) Generation of accessor methods to retrieve flattened entries.
- (Optional) Boolean field bit-packing to reduce memory consumption up to 87,5%.
